plugins.name: AiCommand
plugins.title: FTS AI Chat Plugin (Novelty)
plugins.description: Adds a self-hosted GPT4All chatbot to FTS via the `!ai` command.

plugins.name: ChatMeter
plugins.title: FTS Chat Meter Plugin
plugins.description: Protects FTS chat from flooding by rate-limiting messages per IP using a token bucket system.

plugins.name: ChatOnly
plugins.title: FTS Chat-Only Plugin
plugins.description: Runs FTS in chat-only mode, disabling non-chat TUI components for a clean, focused interface with a !toggle_chat_mode command.

plugins.name: ImprovedChat
plugins.title: FTS Improved Chat Plugin
plugins.description: Adds multiline message support, persistent input history, and consistent user color mapping to FTS chat.

plugins.name: IpBlacklist
plugins.title: FTS Blacklist Plugin
plugins.description: Blocks unwanted IPs from appearing in the TUI using an editable blacklist file and commands.

plugins.name: ThemeCustomizer
plugins.title: FTS Theme Plugin
plugins.description: Adds theming support to FTS via a `theme.ini` file with customizable colors and UI settings.
